paragraphs: Family Farmstead Dairy of Worcester, NY is recalling raw mild cheddar cheese that may be contaminated with E. coli O157:H7, which causes diarrheal illness often with bloody stools [1][10]. The product was distributed to grocers in New York and New Jersey [10]. The cheese is packaged in clear plastic with green, red, and white labeling [10].
Pan Pepín Inc. is recalling certain lots of Para Bien Al Grano due to undeclared sesame, which is an allergen [3]. People with sesame allergies should not consume this product [3].
An E. coli outbreak linked to chicken wraps is growing [7]. The FDA and USDA have not revealed the brand of the wraps [7].
